endorsements.quote: Finally, for the foreseeable future, the intuition and comprehensive assessment of a clinician will remain the centerpiece in all OSA management.

unlisted_practices: Conduct prospective, well-designed studies to determine which forms of telemedicine, in which contexts, provide the most benefit in OSA management.
Use explainable AI models with transparency to build patient trust and balance physician-machine interaction.
Use explainable machine learning for OSA phenotyping and individualized risk stratification rather than relying solely on subgroup associations.

screen.reason: This is a perspective article proposing an integrated framework leveraging telemedicine and AI for obstructive sleep apnea management rather than an empirical study.
